facts.fact: Assabah reports that the national cybersecurity agency (الوكالة الوطنية للسلامة السيبرنية) issued a statement on 30 July 2026, so the agency exists and operates.
The national cybersecurity agency issued a public warning on 30 July 2026 about an SMS phishing campaign using fake traffic-fine notices from foreign numbers to harvest banking data.

Decree-law 2023-17 of 11 March 2023 (Art. 4) creates the Agence nationale de la cybersécurité as a public establishment under the communication technologies ministry, succeeding the earlier ANSI (Art. 27); it takes effect six months after publication.

Decree-law 2023-17 (Arts. 6, 20-21) defines vital digital infrastructure, subjects it to mandatory audit, requires operators to report incidents immediately to the national cyber-emergency contact point, and says the list of operators is fixed by decree; the document does not state that the list was issued.

note: ANCS is named as awarding labels, but the document does not state it was created or handled an incident.
